extracted.intended_audience: general readers, film enthusiasts, researchers, and Wikipedia contributors
extracted.subtask_description: A chronological catalogue of films classified as American comedies, separated into short films and feature-length films, intended as a reference list on Wikipedia. Includes entries by decade and year, with maintenance notes about completeness and sourcing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope / inclusion: American comedy films
rubrics_metrics.description: This is a list of American comedy films.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entries should be films that are both American (by production/origin) and of the comedy genre. The page's title defines the list's scope; items that do not meet both criteria do not belong. (The page itself does not provide an explicit, detailed rule for 'American' production attribution.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Film length classification: short films vs feature films
rubrics_metrics.description: Comedy films are separated into two categories: short films and feature films.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any film over 40 minutes long is considered to be of feature-length (although most feature films produced since 1950 are considerably longer, those made in earlier eras frequently ranged from little more than an hour to as little as four reels, which amounted to about 44 minutes). Use the 40-minute threshold to classify entries as short or feature.

rubrics_metrics.name: Completeness and maintenance: list is incomplete
rubrics_metrics.description: This film-related list is incomplete; you can help by adding missing items. (October 2021)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The list is explicitly marked as incomplete; contributors are invited to add missing films. When adding entries, follow Wikipedia's general list and sourcing practices (provide reliable sources, avoid duplicates, place films in the correct year/decade section).

rubrics_metrics.name: Sourcing / verifiability of entries
rubrics_metrics.description: Many individual entries show '[citation needed]' tags and the page is in hidden categories such as 'All articles with unsourced statements' and 'Articles with unsourced statements from June 2024'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Items or claims lacking citations are flagged; entries should be supported by reliable sources. Maintain verifiability when adding or editing films to avoid '[citation needed]' tags and to comply with Wikipedia content policies.
